title: Refuse mismatched tenant in BFF command admission

ac_1_compare_verified_tenant_against_par.detail: submit_command_admission in services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/service.py resolves trusted_tenant = self._trusted_tenant_for_identity(identity) and compares it against cmd.params keys ('tenant_id', 'tenant', 'tenantId') and nested cmd.params['payload'] keys ('tenant_id', 'tenant', 'tenantId', when dict) before any store lookup, store write, or downstream owner call.

ac_2_http_403_tenant_mismatch_top_level_.detail: Added ErrorCode.TENANT_MISMATCH = 'TENANT_MISMATCH' in services/control-plane/bff/models.py and raised self._raise_error(403, ErrorCode.TENANT_MISMATCH, ...) on mismatch so the normal BFF error shape returns HTTP 403 with top-level error.code == 'TENANT_MISMATCH' and never stringifies it inside another error code; zero downstream owner calls occur and no command is stored or reaches executed.

ac_3_matching_or_absent_param_tenant_and.detail: When params omit tenant keys or match trusted_tenant, submit_command_admission proceeds unchanged and preserves the existing trusted-tenant stamp on stored_params['tenant_id'] and command_envelope.payload['tenant_id']. Callers with no verified tenant (trusted_tenant is None) keep the existing refusal.

ac_4_single_audit_log_line_without_token.detail: Each refusal logs exactly one warning line on services.control_plane.bff.command_adapters.service with operator_id, verified_tenant, claimed_tenant, and command name, and excludes raw JWTs, Bearer headers, and confirm tokens.

ac_5_three_red_tests_on_dev_pass_unchang.detail: test_command_route_binds_owner_write_to_jwt_tenant[EvolutionProgramAction-target0-params0], test_mounted_capital_command_route_scopes_to_the_jwt_tenant[tenant-a-tenant-b-False], and test_mounted_capital_command_route_scopes_to_the_jwt_tenant[tenant-b-tenant-foreign-False] pass unchanged, and no assertion in test_tenant_fallback_audit.py was weakened.

ac_6_new_tests_across_all_admission_entr.detail: Added test_command_admission_refuses_foreign_tenant_claims_and_logs_without_token (6 parameterizations covering tenant_id, tenant, tenantId at top-level params and inside params.payload) and test_command_admission_entries_refuse_foreign_tenant_with_signed_jwt (10 parameterizations covering POST /bff/v1/commands, resource action routes PATCH /bff/deployments/plan-a and POST /bff/evolution-programs/program-a/actions/pause_program, persona lifecycle route POST /bff/personas/persona-a/actions/AdvanceLifecycle, and assistant command submission via execute_governed_tool / POST /bff/assistant/tools/execute, across both top-level and nested params.payload tenant claims, asserting HTTP 403 TENANT_MISMATCH, zero owner calls, zero stored commands, and one token-free audit log line).

ac_7_required_branch_ci_smoke_acceptance.detail: Added unconditional step 'BFF tenant fallback audit gate' running 'python3 -m pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_tenant_fallback_audit.py' in jobs.smoke of .github/workflows/branch-ci.yml and pinned it in scripts/test_branch_ci_gate_selection.py::BranchCiGateSelectionTests.test_tenant_fallback_audit_step_pinned. Negative control verified: without the new admission check in service.py, pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_tenant_fallback_audit.py exits with code 1 (3 failed on baseline dev tests, 19 failed including the 16 new refusal test cases).

ac_8_contract_documentation_and_scope_di.detail: Updated services/control-plane/bff/BFF_COMMAND_API_CONTRACT.md Section 4 (Required Admission Controls) and Section 6 (Response Shape error code table) to document the HTTP 403 TENANT_MISMATCH refusal. No other routes or out-of-scope failing tests were modified.
